entries.description: Re-validated LY spec section 7 data-* contract against inkscape-music-glyph-toolkit music_glyph_toolkit.py (the authority): data-semitone-height and opt-in data-lilypond-notehead/-hollow ARE emitted; data-stem-up-x/y and data-stem-down-x/y are NOT emitted by the current toolkit (it deletes them as stale) - stem attachment is conveyed by rect id=stem-up/stem-down placemarker geometry (anchor = bottom-center of stem-up, top-center of stem-down). Drift documented in the module header and handled by the importer.

Built cnb/ui/svg-importer.js (Module 16): pure extract()/buildShape() producing Module A config.shapes[name] entries (svgPath, svgHollowPath, natural dims, semitoneHeight, 4-point anchors from stem rects, verbatim lilypondPath/lilypondHollowPath, import-time lilypondAnchors), parseSvgText() DOMParser wrapper; import UI test page cnb/test-pages/test-svg-importer.html (file picker + drag-drop + built-in sample + Module 6 preview with anchor markers); 26 unit tests in cnb/tests/cnb-svg-importer-tests.js registered in run-tests.js. All 289 cnb tests and 240 legacy tests pass. Per-session UAT (uatStyle dsl): 20/20 checks via headless Chromium, recorded in s1-uat.md.

Verification round 1 (gpt-5-4) returned ISSUES_FOUND with 3 issues; all remediated: (1) natural dims now sourced viewBox -> root width/height -> error, never inventing a square width; (2) LY spec 7.1 data-stem-up/down-x/y attributes supported as anchor fallback when stem rects are absent (rects take precedence); (3) reusable renderImportControl() added to the module, test page now hosts it. 7 new unit tests (296/296 cnb, 240/240 legacy), browser UAT re-run 20/20. Round 2 verdict: VERIFIED.

Built cnb/ui/palette-editor.js (Module 12): ported CIEDE2000 color math, NAMED_COLORS, nearestColorName, matchToCBSafe, curated standard/CB-safe palettes and toSchemeSymbol pipeline from legacy; buildPalette maps selections to per-PC Module A config.palette (cycling pool, matched or identity CB branch per LY spec 4.5, schemeSymbols); render() UI with preset tabs, custom editor, CB match panel, useCBSafe toggle, per-PC preview. 36 unit tests incl. render() DOM-stub and Module A/11 integration; cnb suite 333/333, legacy 240/240; UAT 27/27 via Playwright DSL checklist (s2-uat.md).

Naming/attribution check applied to every surfaced label: preset labels are color-descriptive only (Dark2 - N colors / CB-Safe - N colors / Custom - N colors); attribution footnote credits ColorBrewer Dark2 and Paul Tol CB-safe schemes and marks the 11-color sets as project-own; automated unit test asserts no palette label or color name matches external notation-system names (Clairnote, Lyre, Kite, etc.).
